verdict.rationale: An ML/GPU cloud platform could plausibly ship an in-product AI assistant that surfaces insights from user data, so this axis applies. The evidence pack documents no such feature. Notebooks, Deployments and Workflows are compute primitives that a user could use to build their own analysis, which are developer building blocks rather than built-in AI-generated insights or suggestions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
